_about: Compositions: named sequences of entries. An entry is an element name, a sub-composition name, or either followed by ' x N'; 'say: text' is an annotation shown and read aloud before the next entry; an entry in parentheses, like '(underarm bringback)', is quiet: danced but not announced, and not a stop for the swipes. Sub-compositions (made of elements) are used inside compositions by name; the composer picks each element's starting condition from the previous element's end.

compositions.name: 5 minutes exercise
elements: send out and bring back x4
compositions.notes: The daily exercise. Its philosophy (the user, 2026-11-16): as short as possible, with as many elements as possible packed into it. It is not aimed at 5 minutes: it is aimed at a good amount of elements in the least time, which comes to about 3 minutes now. The order serves that: ordered well, the elements pack better (fewer bridges between them) and the whole makes more sense to the person dancing it, so it feels less chaotic. That is why it does not follow Explore's order: what does not turn comes first (rock triple triple, quiet; side to side 2; send out and bring back 4; yoyo 8), then the turns in the user's order: follower underarm and back 2, follower underarm pass 2, lead underarm pass 2, follower underarm to arrow 2, rock back cutoff 2, circle 2, underarm circle 4 (never more than 4, the user), tak turn 10. Few repeats: two of what is known well, a few more of what is new. Quiet bridges only where two elements do not fit: a follower underarm pass before the face-to-face passes, an underarm bringback after them and between the underarm circles; the fourth circle leaves the couple face to face for the tak turns, which end the exercise. A 'say:' line names a run of quiet entries once; its ', N times' is for the voice, which says how often an entry repeats, while the screen never writes it. When a new element comes: find the place where it packs best and makes sense, give it the most repeats, and take repeats away elsewhere to keep the whole short.

compositions.name: Quick recap
compositions.notes: Every element once, in the order the user learned them (user 2026-11-16), joined by quiet bridges where one element does not end the way the next one starts; the last bridge brings the couple back to side by side so the launcher's little floor loops it without a jump.

sub_compositions.name: rock triple triple
sub_compositions.notes: Rock step, triple step, triple step: the six-count basic (user 2026-10-18). Works from side and from facing.

sub_compositions.name: follower underarm and back
sub_compositions.notes: Follower underarm pass out to face to face and the underarm bringback back to side by side (the user's name, 2026-10-19).

sub_compositions.name: send out and bring back
sub_compositions.notes: Send out to face to face, bring back to side by side (user 2026-11-16).
